programme.title: Trapped in the Game: Fool Me Once
programme.desc: When FBI agent Dallas Bush is assigned to take down a powerful businessman turned drug lord, he realizes the payout could cover his dying mother’s medical expenses. Dallas must navigate a dangerous web of deception, crime, and moral compromise, where every choice comes with a price.

programme.title: Scandalous
programme.desc: Lady Watts, a bestselling author, reveals secrets about her affairs with those closest to her in her latest memoir. At her launch party, a heated argument turns violent, and she's left unconscious. As detectives investigate, secrets, love triangles, and betrayal emerge. The search for the attacker leads to twists and turns, involving everyone from her talent manager to her labelmate. The truth about the night of the attack is slowly revealed, with unexpected consequences for all involved.

programme.title: Blood or Not
programme.desc: Two brothers, one of the law, the other of the streets, find themselves making the choice of "Blood" or "Not".

programme.title: Blood and Money
programme.desc: Four cousins from a tight-knit family are thrust into a world of chaos when the youngest is suspected of stealing money from one of Memphis' most dangerous drug dealers. With their lives on the line, they must figure out how to make sixty thousand dollars in two weeks, all while plotting their revenge. When one of them falls for the mark, things get more complicated.

programme.title: Bissonnet 2: Back on the Blade
programme.desc: A serial killer is prowling Bissonnet street in Houston, and is targeting prostitutes. Detective Wallace and Benjamin are on the case, and will stop at nothing to bring him to justice.

programme.title: Caught in a Trapp
programme.desc: The story of a young teen who was abused by his father. Following the tragic death of his parents, he grew up on the streets and is forced into a life of running from D Slug, a known drug lord, after selling drugs from his opps!

programme.title: Counterplay
programme.desc: Antwan Walker and his beautiful wife Nia have the perfect marriage. When Antwan’s wandering eye leads him to flirt with his co-worker Monica, what follows is a psychological thriller as Antwan slowly realizes that Monica has a hidden agenda.

programme.title: Cuffin Season
programme.desc: Nate is a part-time Uber drive and a music video director, and is becoming a rising star in the music and video world. Everything is going great, except for the fact that he doesn’t have citizenship. He knows the easiest way for him to get citizenship is to get married, but he won’t settle for just any woman. Will he run out of time before immigration is onto him?

programme.title: Dangerous Affair
programme.desc: Erika and Ryan are a happily married couple living in a high rise Apartment in Atlanta, Ga. everything is going great until Erika meets a handsome, mysterious man in her building and they start having an affair. Once Ryan finds out about the affair Erika ends it. But the mystery man has other plans. Will the married couple survive the Dangerous Affair?

programme.title: Fall Semester
programme.desc: Kid Kypree is a college student with dreams and ambitions of becoming the next great stand-up comic. One night he gets invited to a party hosted by his old friend Bo that thrusts him into a whirlwind of opportunities and challenges that will test his friendships, resolve, and his sense of humor. He will soon discover that success comes with its own set of comedic twists and turns!

programme.title: Killer Baby Daddy
programme.desc: Ciera and her baby daddy Byron are not getting along after she catches him on the phone with another woman. Ciera tries to make the relationship work but Byron doesn't want to change his ways. Ciera decides to call it quits with Byron. While jogging in the park one day, Ciera runs into her high school sweetheart, Curtis. When Byron finds out about Ciera’s new man, he begins to destroy everything in her life. Ciera must protect her baby and her life before Byron kills everyone she loves.

programme.title: Mama's Hands
programme.desc: A woman, who was abused as a child by her mentally ill mother, sets out on a journey to find healing through forgiveness. She discovers that she may be too late.

programme.title: The Princess Killers
programme.desc: Two friends take a chance to change their lives and become partners in the world of crime, and build reputations as strong, no nonsense, business women. They soon discover it’s lonely at the top, when their enemies close in on them, while maintaining their own friendship.

programme.title: A Chosen Hope
programme.desc: After escaping her abusive husband, Talia has forged a new life for her and her daughter, Hope. When Hope begins experiencing mental illness and troubling visions, Talia learns her husband was part of a sinister cult, and Hope is marked as “The Chosen Soul.” Talia must race against time to save her daughter before it’s too late.

programme.title: A Wolf's Cries
programme.desc: Janice is a compulsive liar. In her new friend group, she causes chaos, breaking up couples and getting friends arrested. Believing she deserves everything; it's her way or the highway. Until someone sees her manipulation and aims to expose her.
